imageStyle: Use case: product-mockup. ONE premium photorealistic women's e-commerce garment photograph. Warm off-white seamless studio backdrop, soft diffused light from upper left, accurate neutral color, realistic fabric weave and seams. Vertical 4:5 frame, full garment front view centered, complete garment including hem and cuffs visible, about 78% frame fill with clean margins. Invisible mannequin / ghost mannequin styling with naturally filled shoulders and drape, no human body, no hanger, no text, no logo, no watermark, no collage, no props or accessories. Match an elegant consistent modern apparel catalog. Subject:
